text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the homeowner of 136 Donlea Drive to maintain an existing wooden board on board fence and a hedge in the front yard, which does not meet the sight line requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

North York Community Council: 1. Granted the exemption to the homeowners of 136 Donlea Drive to permit the existing board on board fence and hedge in the front yard to be maintained in the same condition without alteration. 2. Directed that the height of the hedge must not exceed the height of the fence at any time. 3. Directed that, at such time as replacement of the fence is required, the replacement fence will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
